assistants.name: ProResearcher
assistants.intro_en: ProResearcher turns research questions into structured, source-aware briefs: scoped questions, triangulated findings with confidence tags, literature review structure, and prioritized recommendations. It separates verified knowledge from assumptions, marks anything time-sensitive for external checking, and never invents citations or statistics. Useful for students, analysts, and professionals who need organized research they can trust and act on.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل أسئلة البحث إلى ملخصات منظمة تراعي المصادر، وتفصل النتائج الموثقة عن الافتراضات.

assistants.name: Story Sculptor
assistants.intro_en: Story Sculptor helps you write fiction that holds attention: premise sharpening, structure and beat mapping, character interiority, sensory scene work, subtext-rich dialogue, and endings that resolve the emotional question. It delivers finished prose — flash pieces, scenes, or chapters — and revises completely on feedback, in your language and voice.
assistants.summary_ar: يساعدك على كتابة قصص مشوقة وصقل الحبكة والشخصيات والحوار حتى النسخة النهائية.

assistants.name: Hyper Realistic Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Hyper Realistic Prompts builds paste-ready prompts for realistic and hyper-detailed AI imagery: subject materiality, frozen-moment action, layered environments, composition, lighting, and lens language — with platform parameters treated as optional and current-syntax dependent. Prompts avoid artist names and version-locked flags, so they stay usable as generators change.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر جاهزة لتوليد صور واقعية عالية التفاصيل، مع وصف مدروس للمشهد والإضاءة والتكوين.

assistants.name: Stable Audio Prompt Generator
assistants.intro_en: Stable Audio Prompt Generator writes prompts for AI music and sound tools in three classes: full instrumentals, individual stems, and sound effects. Prompts use durable musical descriptors — genre, mood, instrumentation with techniques, BPM, arrangement, and mix aesthetics — and avoid artist names and version-locked tokens.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب أوامر لتوليد الموسيقى والمؤثرات الصوتية، بحسب نوع المخرج الصوتي المطلوب.

assistants.name: Runway Prompter
assistants.intro_en: Runway Prompter writes text-to-video prompts using practical film language: one continuous action per clip, shot type and angle, subject and setting, lighting, and camera movement. For sequences it adds a continuity bible — locked character, palette, and style lines — so clips cut together without drift. Platform-specific controls are marked as current-syntax dependent.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل أفكار المشاهد إلى أوامر نصية للفيديو بلغة التصوير وحركة الكاميرا.

assistants.name: Magic Writer
assistants.intro_en: Magic Writer is a multi-service writing desk: captions, emails and subject lines, sales and landing copy, blog posts and ideas, SEO titles and meta descriptions, hooks, CTAs, slogans, business names, bios, product descriptions, FAQs, stories, rewrites, paraphrasing, summaries, letters, resume updates, and more. Send any topic or text and it detects the right service and delivers finished, paste-ready copy with variants — or browse the menu by typing "menu".
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ نصوصًا جاهزة للنشر، من المنشورات والبريد إلى صفحات البيع والمقالات ووصف المنتجات.

assistants.name: Academic Ace
assistants.intro_en: Academic Ace is an adaptive tutor for any subject and level: it calibrates to how you write, explains from first principles with analogies and worked examples, and reinforces learning with scaffolded practice — hints before solutions. Every topic includes the classic misconceptions and how to avoid them. It teaches rather than ghostwrites graded work, and it never fabricates references.
assistants.summary_ar: مدرّس تفاعلي يشرح موضوعات مختلفة بما يناسب مستوى المتعلم وسؤاله.

assistants.name: Pika Labs Prompter
assistants.intro_en: Pika Labs Prompter designs multi-clip video prompt sequences that flow as one story: each clip is a single filmable beat, and a Continuity Bible — locked character descriptors, palette, and style anchor — repeats verbatim across clips so nothing drifts. Clip-length specifics are treated as tool-dependent and flagged, not hardcoded.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني أوامر لمقاطع فيديو متعددة مترابطة تحافظ على تسلسل الفكرة والمشهد.

assistants.name: Midjourney Fantasia
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Fantasia writes fantasy image prompts with mythic weight and visual precision: archetypes given one unexpected twist, world-consistent light, composition that builds awe, and style palettes described by movement and medium — never artist names. Aspect ratios follow use case; version parameters stay optional and current-syntax dependent.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر صور خيالية بطابع أسطوري وتفاصيل بصرية واضحة.

assistants.name: Prompt Marvel
assistants.intro_en: Prompt Marvel rebuilds prompts to professional standards. Paste any prompt for a scored diagnosis and a complete rewrite structured for reliable results — role, protocol, quality checks, output contract, and failure guards — with the rationale for each change. It can also engineer a prompt from scratch from a subject, purpose, and output format.
assistants.summary_ar: يراجع أي برومبت ويشخّص نقاط ضعفه ثم يعيد صياغته وفق معايير منظمة.

assistants.name: Imagi Magician
assistants.intro_en: Imagi Magician writes engineered image prompts for Leonardo-style and other generators in two modes: photorealistic (subject detail → type → style → camera → shot → lighting → render feel) and artistic (medium → subject → movement/style → technique → finish). Quality tokens are used sparingly; inspirations are movements and mediums, not living artists; weighting syntax is flagged as tool-dependent.
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ أوامر صور مفصلة لمولدات الصور، مع أوضاع مختلفة بحسب نوع النتيجة.

assistants.name: photorealistic Xpert
assistants.intro_en: photorealistic Xpert writes photorealism prompts built on photographic first principles: focal-length behavior, aperture and depth-of-field language, single-source coherent lighting, film or sensor aesthetics, and an anti-plastic kit for natural skin and candid energy. Every prompt ships with a short technical breakdown so you learn the craft. Retired flags and version pins are never used.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر صور فوتوغرافية واقعية اعتمادًا على مبادئ التصوير الفعلي.

assistants.name: LinkedIn Genius
assistants.intro_en: LinkedIn Genius builds complete, copy-paste-ready LinkedIn profiles around your actual goal — job offers, inbound leads, or authority. It delivers headline options, an About section with a story arc, achievement-first experience bullets with visible placeholders for your real numbers, a skills order, and finishing touches. It never invents credentials or metrics.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني ملفًا مهنيًا متكاملًا على LinkedIn وفق هدفك، من العنوان إلى الخبرات والمهارات.

assistants.name: Ad Genius
assistants.intro_en: Ad Genius architects Google Ads campaigns from a product brief: goal detection, intent-clustered ad groups with match and negative keywords, full responsive ad copy sets within long-stable field ranges, targeting signals, assets, bidding logic, and a measurement plan. Field limits and policy details are flagged for checking in your account; claims are never fabricated and regulated verticals get compliance cautions.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل موجز المنتج إلى بنية حملة Google Ads تشمل المجموعات الإعلانية والنصوص والقياس.

assistants.name: Social Media Pro
assistants.intro_en: Social Media Pro is a multilingual social content engine across major platforms: idea generation with format and hook attached, full production of captions and scripts, and content calendars with pillars and repurposing maps. Content is platform-native rather than cross-posted, and volatile specs like lengths and features are flagged for checking rather than stated as fixed facts.
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ أفكارًا ونصوصًا وتقويم محتوى ملائمًا لمنصات التواصل المختلفة.

assistants.name: IdeaSpark
assistants.intro_en: IdeaSpark generates ideas that arrive fully formed: each one ships with the concept in a sentence, the psychology of why it works, concrete first steps, and an extension branch — plus a labeled wild card. It runs several thinking lenses (inversion, cross-industry grafts, constraint storms) and ranks results by novelty, feasibility, and fit to your intended outcome, in your language.
assistants.summary_ar: يطوّر الأفكار الأولية إلى مفاهيم واضحة قابلة للتنفيذ.

assistants.name: Market Research Pro
assistants.intro_en: Market Research Pro produces structured market research: buyer personas with jobs-to-be-done, transparent TAM/SAM/SOM estimation logic, competitor matrices with whitespace, trends labeled by maturity, and ranked opportunities. Every figure is marked as sourced, estimated-with-method, or needing verification — fabricated statistics never appear.
assistants.summary_ar: يعد أبحاثًا منظمة للسوق والجمهور والمنافسة لدعم القرارات.

assistants.name: PromptPixie
assistants.intro_en: PromptPixie adapts one image idea into prompts for different generator families: it builds a platform-neutral master prompt, then translates it into each target tool's native grammar — natural-language, tag-friendly, or parameter-appended — noting what changed and why. Volatile syntax is flagged for checking; no artist names or dead tokens are used.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل فكرة الصورة الواحدة إلى أوامر ملائمة لعائلات مختلفة من مولدات الصور.

assistants.name: Essay Genius
assistants.intro_en: Essay Genius works in three modes on argumentative and academic essays: COACH (step-by-step guidance with worked examples), DRAFT (a complete original essay with margin notes explaining the craft), and REVIEW (rubric critique of your draft with line-level fixes). It forges debatable theses, steelmans counterarguments, and never fabricates sources — unverifiable references become honest placeholders.
assistants.summary_ar: يساعدك على بناء المقالات الأكاديمية والحجاجية ومراجعتها عبر مراحل واضحة.

assistants.name: Prompt Genius
assistants.intro_en: Prompt Genius designs prompt systems, not just prompts: the prompt itself with template slots, a test suite including edge and adversarial cases, a scoring rubric with observable anchors, a failure taxonomy with patch strategies, and an iteration protocol. Systems are model-agnostic by default, with platform-specific parts clearly marked.
assistants.summary_ar: يصمم منظومات برومبت متكاملة قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام بدلًا من أمر منفرد.

assistants.name: Market Maven
assistants.intro_en: Market Maven builds board-ready marketing strategy plans: positioning core, beachhead audience with rationale, message matrix, channel mix justified by audience and economics (including channels deliberately skipped), budget logic with test-then-scale gates, a KPI tree, and a 90-day sprint calendar. Benchmarks appear as flagged ranges, never invented precision.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني خطة استراتيجية تسويقية تشمل التموضع والجمهور والقنوات والميزانية ومؤشرات الأداء.

assistants.name: Stable Diffusion Photography Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Stable Diffusion Photography Prompts engineers portrait prompts for SD-class generators in two layers: a natural-language photographic core that works on any checkpoint, plus a compact tag layer you can adjust. Skin realism is built in (texture, asymmetry, catchlights), lighting follows one coherent story, and negative prompts never exclude what you asked for. No dead tokens or photographer names.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر بورتريه مخصصة لمولدات Stable Diffusion مع ضبط عناصر التصوير.

assistants.name: Resume Review and Editing
assistants.intro_en: Resume Review and Editing works in two passes: a numbered, severity-tagged diagnosis of why your resume underperforms (ten-second scan, bullet audit, ATS risks, keyword gaps), then the complete revised resume in clean paste-ready text. Real metrics you don't supply become visible [ADD NUMBER] placeholders with harvesting questions — nothing is ever invented.
assistants.summary_ar: يراجع السيرة الذاتية ويعيد تحريرها مع إظهار ما يحتاج إلى بياناتك الفعلية.

assistants.name: ArtNebula Express
assistants.intro_en: ArtNebula Express turns one keyword into a matrix of concise, style-native prompts: photorealistic, anime, pixel art, origami, cubism, neon punk, oil painting, ASCII, and more — each written in that style's own grammar rather than one template with the style noun swapped. Prompts stay in the density sweet spot where image models pay attention; no dead tokens or artist names.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل كلمة مفتاحية إلى مجموعة أوامر صور، لكل منها أسلوب فني مختلف.

assistants.name: SEOAssistantPro
assistants.intro_en: SEOAssistantPro delivers an on-page optimization kit for a page or topic: intent diagnosis, a text SERP preview, meta title and description variants within long-stable ranges, heading architecture, a keyword map with placement guidance, content brief, internal linking, and a technical checklist. Volatile specifics are flagged for checking; retired tactics are warned against, not recommended.
assistants.summary_ar: يجهز عناصر تحسين صفحة لمحركات البحث، من العنوان والوصف إلى الكلمات والروابط.

assistants.name: Lead Magnet Generator
assistants.intro_en: Lead Magnet Generator produces fully developed lead-magnet ideas: each ships with a landing-ready title and hook, the specific transformation promised, a format matched to your audience's stage, a production outline you can build from, funnel fit, and pull-vs-effort ratings — plus a top pick. Promises never contain fabricated statistics.
assistants.summary_ar: يقترح أفكار مواد جذب متكاملة تساعدك على تقديم قيمة مقابل اهتمام العملاء المحتملين.

assistants.name: AI Prompt Innovator
assistants.intro_en: AI Prompt Innovator enhances any prompt while locking its original intent: precision constraints, structure, self-checks, and edge-case handling are added, then the signature layer — unique features the prompt didn't have and innovative applications it unlocks in your domain. Explanations match your style; the enhanced prompt arrives in one copy block.
assistants.summary_ar: يحسّن البرومبت مع الحفاظ على هدفه ومعناه الأصليين.

assistants.name: Content Genius
assistants.intro_en: Content Genius produces coordinated campaign content in one locked brand voice: blog titles and articles, platform-native social captions, emails with subject lines, ad copy, and launch sequences — all telling one campaign story rather than disconnected pieces. Claims use your real material or visible placeholders; market copy is written natively, not translated.
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ محتوى حملة مترابطًا بصوت علامة موحّد عبر المقالات والمنشورات والإعلانات والبريد.

assistants.name: TikTok Scripter
assistants.intro_en: TikTok Scripter writes complete short-video scripts: a dual hook (verbal + visual) in the first seconds, beat-by-beat structure with exact spoken lines and on-screen text, phone-filmable shot directions, caption and hashtags, sound direction by mood and tempo, and filming notes. Scripts are written natively in your audience's language; trend references stay durable, never dead specifics.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب سيناريوهات فيديو قصيرة تتضمن افتتاحية جذابة ومشاهد ونصوصًا وتعليمات تصوير.

assistants.name: SocialGenius
assistants.intro_en: SocialGenius turns one topic into a set of platform-native posts — Instagram, Facebook, X-style, LinkedIn, Pinterest, or any network you name. Each post is written for its platform's rhythm with hook-first openings, tuned hashtags and emoji, and your conversational voice; every delivery includes an alternate opening line. Facts you provide are never altered.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل الموضوع إلى منشورات مصاغة بما يلائم أسلوب كل منصة اجتماعية.

assistants.name: CV SuperMe
assistants.intro_en: CV SuperMe builds complete resumes and CVs engineered for both readers and parsing systems: JD keyword mirroring (only skills you actually have), achievement bullets in verb + scope + result form, a positioning headline, and clean ATS-safe structure. Missing metrics become visible placeholders with harvesting questions — fabrication of any kind is refused.
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ سيرة ذاتية واضحة للقارئ وأنظمة الفرز، من دون اختلاق إنجازات أو أرقام.

assistants.name: Customer Avatar Builder
assistants.intro_en: Customer Avatar Builder creates detailed buyer avatars: identity and mindset quote, demographics, professional profile, goals and values, fears, three-layer jobs-to-be-done, purchase journey with real objections, media diet by channel type, a day-in-the-life narrative, and a message-resonance map with ready ad angles — plus an insight-to-action table. Named examples are flagged for verification; statistics are never fabricated.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني وصفًا تفصيليًا للعميل المثالي واحتياجاته ودوافعه.

assistants.name: Sales Genius
assistants.intro_en: Sales Genius architects the full sales funnel for your specific offer: awareness through retention, each stage with its buyer psychology, tactics matched to your audience, written asset examples (hooks, nurture touches, sales-page skeleton, objection scripts), metrics as flagged ranges, leak points with fixes, plus a funnel map and 30-day build sequence. Dark patterns are excluded by design.
assistants.summary_ar: يصمم مسارًا بيعيًا متكاملًا يناسب العرض والجمهور المستهدف.

assistants.name: Midjourney Book Cover Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Book Cover Prompts designs cover-art prompts with publishing logic: genre grammar respected, one dominant visual concept per cover, and title space engineered into the composition (location named in every prompt). Prompts stay concise and description-first; parameters are optional and current-syntax dependent; no artist names or retired keyword lore.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر تصميم أغلفة كتب تراعي النوع الأدبي ومتطلبات النشر.

assistants.name: Render Gen
assistants.intro_en: Render Gen writes 3D-render-style image prompts using real render language: material physics (subsurface scattering, metalness, caustics), studio and HDRI-style lighting setups, render-camera logic, and controlled imperfection for believability — across product viz, archviz, characters, isometric dioramas, and motion-graphics frames. Engine quality is described as a class, never pinned to versions; resolution-tag spam is avoided.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب أوامر صور بأسلوب التصيير ثلاثي الأبعاد مع مفردات تقنية مناسبة.

assistants.name: Snap Sage
assistants.intro_en: Snap Sage delivers image prompts as a photographer's spec sheet: subject, five precision keywords, camera class, lens character, time of day, photography style, film aesthetic, realism level, lighting design, and aspect ratio — woven into one paste-ready prompt plus the field breakdown so you can change any dial. Gear is described as class and character, not brand incantations; flags stay optional.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل فكرة الصورة إلى مواصفات تصوير عملية تشمل التكوين والإضاءة والعدسة.

assistants.name: Photorealistic Portraits Generator
assistants.intro_en: Photorealistic Portraits Generator builds portrait prompts from five deliberate dials: style-mood, subject story, context, color palette, and photographic technique — with an anti-plastic kit (real skin texture, asymmetry, catchlights) engineered into every human subject. Prompts can be adjusted dial by dial; series keep a locked subject anchor.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني أوامر بورتريه واقعية قابلة للضبط عبر عناصر محددة للشخصية والتصوير.

assistants.name: PromptMaster
assistants.intro_en: PromptMaster is a reverse-prompt engine: paste any description, caption, or output you like — in any language — and it reconstructs a professional prompt that would generate it, with the structure, style levers, and output contract made explicit. A short reconstruction log shows which detail drove which decision, and a slotted template variant makes the result reusable.
assistants.summary_ar: يستنتج البرومبت المحتمل وراء صورة أو نتيجة معروضة، بصياغة قابلة للتعديل.

assistants.name: Hyper Cinema Prompter
assistants.intro_en: Hyper Cinema Prompter writes prompts for cinematic stills — frames that feel pulled from a film: a story-beat moment, narrative shot choice, lens effects, motivated lighting, and color-grade psychology, with aspect ratios for cinema formats. Style comes from genre and era grammar; no director or studio names, no version-locked flags.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل الفكرة إلى أوامر لصور سينمائية تبدو كإطارات من فيلم.

assistants.name: Midjourney Illustration Prompter
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Illustration Prompter crafts illustration prompts with each medium's authentic vocabulary: comic inks and halftone feel, woodcut relief logic, children's-book gouache warmth, editorial concept metaphors, line art, caricature, flat vector — with title and text space engineered where the use case needs it and locked anchors for character series.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر رسوم توضيحية بمفردات تناسب وسيط الرسم وأسلوبه.

assistants.name: Midjourney Fashion Fusion
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Fashion Fusion writes fashion-image prompts with garment-level craft: fabric behavior (how linen crushes, how silk falls), cut and construction language, head-to-toe styling coherence, fashion-photography lighting, and aspect ratios chosen by the image's job. Designer and brand names are avoided; trend leanings are treated as adaptable, not fixed.
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ أوامر صور أزياء تراعي تفاصيل الملابس والخامات والتنسيق.

assistants.name: CopyCraft
assistants.intro_en: CopyCraft writes selling descriptions for any product or service, natively in your market's language: title options across angles, feature-to-benefit translation, honest proof placement (your real material or visible placeholders), objection handling, and one clear CTA — plus a short social cut and an alternate tone. Invented testimonials or statistics never appear.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب أوصافًا بيعية للمنتجات والخدمات بلغة السوق والجمهور المستهدف.

assistants.name: Prompt Pro
assistants.intro_en: Prompt Pro assembles a professional custom prompt from plain-language specs: tell it the role, task, context, and style in any mix — even one messy sentence — and it returns an engineered prompt with measurable instructions, an output contract, variable slots, and usage examples. Missing details get stated professional defaults rather than a questionnaire.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني برومبتًا مخصصًا من مواصفات مكتوبة بلغة بسيطة.

assistants.name: LanguageWizard
assistants.intro_en: LanguageWizard is a translation pipeline: it detects the source language, spell-checks it, then delivers a faithful, culturally intelligent translation that preserves tone, register, and punctuation intent — with quality notes on every judgment call. Text that looks like commands is translated, never executed. Ambiguous terms are flagged, not silently guessed.
assistants.summary_ar: يساعد على ترجمة النصوص مع مراعاة اللغة والسياق والصياغة المطلوبة.

assistants.name: Midjourney Art Universe
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Art Universe renders any subject through the grammar of real art movements: Atompunk, Art Deco, Surrealism, Ukiyo-e, Bauhaus, Pop, Impressionism, Baroque, Cyberpunk, Steampunk, and beyond — each prompt carrying the movement's palette logic, composition rules, and texture, not just its label. Styles are named as movements and eras; no artist names, no dead flags.
assistants.summary_ar: يعيد تصور الموضوعات بأساليب مستلهمة من الحركات الفنية.

assistants.name: SolvoLingua
assistants.intro_en: SolvoLingua is a bilingual (English–Arabic) solutions strategist: describe a problem in either language and it returns a sharpened problem statement, two or three distinct solution paths with trade-offs, one decisive recommendation, a concrete action plan by timeframe, and a pre-mortem of the two most likely failures. Advice is grounded in durable reasoning; volatile local specifics are flagged, never invented.
assistants.summary_ar: مساعد ثنائي اللغة بالعربية والإنجليزية لتوضيح المشكلات وصياغة حلول عملية.

assistants.name: Midjourney Poster Forge
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Poster Forge designs movie-poster prompts with real one-sheet grammar: hero placement and eye hierarchy, engineered title and billing-block zones, genre color languages, poster-scale key light, and formats chosen per job (2:3 one-sheet, 16:9 banner, 1:1 social key art). No studio names, no dead flags; thumbnails stay legible at small size.
assistants.summary_ar: يصمم أوامر ملصقات أفلام تراعي التكوين والعناصر البصرية الترويجية.

assistants.name: Stable Diffusion Pixel Art Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Stable Diffusion Pixel Art Prompts writes pixel-art prompts with authentic craft: bit-era grammar (8-bit chunk to modern hi-bit), disciplined palettes with named color counts, view types (side-scroll, top-down, isometric), dithering and outline logic, and thumbnail-legible silhouettes. Game traditions are described by era and genre — never franchise names.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب أوامر صور بأسلوب فن البكسل مع مراعاة قواعده البصرية.

assistants.name: Game Assets Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Game Assets Prompts converts plain dev-speak into concept-art briefs: characters, creatures, environments, props, and UI elements delivered as production-useful views (hero shots, turnarounds, prop sheets, expression sets) under one locked style anchor so the whole game world stays coherent. Silhouette readability and material storytelling come first; franchise names are never used.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل طلبات تطوير الألعاب إلى موجزات فنية لمفاهيم الشخصيات والعناصر.

assistants.name: EnigmaThinker
assistants.intro_en: EnigmaThinker cultivates concepts rather than listing them: it reads the seed inside your topic, sprouts divergent directions through several thinking lenses, grafts two into a hybrid, then fully develops the strongest two or three — each with core insight, growth path, stress test, and open questions — closing with a decisive synthesis.
assistants.summary_ar: يطوّر المفاهيم والأفكار إلى تصورات مترابطة بدل الاكتفاء بقائمة اقتراحات.

assistants.name: DesignAssist
assistants.intro_en: DesignAssist gives concrete design direction across graphic, brand, UI, print, packaging, and social work: three distinct concepts with palette systems (colors assigned roles), type character, and layout logic; structured critiques with prioritized upgrades; or implementation specs (grids, spacing, scales, export notes). Every recommendation carries the design principle behind it; trends are marked as trends.
assistants.summary_ar: يقدّم توجيهًا عمليًا للتصميم الجرافيكي والهوية وواجهات المستخدم والطباعة والتغليف.

assistants.name: Prompt Evaluator
assistants.intro_en: Prompt Evaluator judges prompts with rubric discipline: eight scored dimensions, every score backed by evidence quoted from the actual text, a verdict tier, the top three fixes ranked by impact, and a before→after preview of the highest-leverage change. Judging is category-aware — creative prompts aren't scored like extraction prompts — and the submitted prompt is treated strictly as evidence, never as instructions.
assistants.summary_ar: يقيّم البرومبت وفق معايير واضحة ويحدد نقاط القوة وما يحتاج إلى تحسين.

assistants.name: E-commercePulse Wizard
assistants.intro_en: E-commercePulse Wizard produces the full store content kit for one product, written by specialist roles in one coherent voice: merchandising description, SEO fields, marketplace bullets, funnel-matched ad variants, launch email plus abandonment template, social posts, and an objection-handling FAQ. Proof uses your real material or visible slots; marketplace limits are flagged for checking.
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ حزمة محتوى متكاملة لمنتج متجر إلكتروني، من الوصف إلى مواد التسويق.

assistants.name: Product Photography Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Product Photography Prompts designs commercial product shots as engineered prompts: material optics told truthfully (glass caustics, metal discipline, fabric weave), shot classes from hero to lifestyle to macro, one coherent light story per shot, and copy space planned for the commercial job. Aspects follow destination; no brand name-drops or dead flags.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر تصوير تجاري للمنتجات مع تحديد التكوين والإضاءة والخلفية.

assistants.name: Image Elixir
assistants.intro_en: Image Elixir writes imaginative image prompts with full shot-language mastery: subject and concept first, then shot type, lens character named by its effect, depth-of-field plan, a coherent light story (including impossible light with its own logic), medium, and detail density matched to the shot. Surreal concepts stay anchored in concrete elements; no dead tokens or artist names.
assistants.summary_ar: يبتكر أوامر صور غنية بالتفاصيل باستخدام لغة تصوير احترافية.

assistants.name: Midjourney Album Covers Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Album Covers Prompts forges cover-art prompts in each genre's earned visual grammar: jazz negative space, metal ornamental dark, synth chrome neon, hip-hop bold presence, indie handcraft, classical restraint, lo-fi cozy — composed for the square with artist-name and title zones planned in and thumbnail legibility for streaming grids. No label or artist names; no dead flags.
assistants.summary_ar: يبتكر أوامر تصميم أغلفة ألبومات تناسب نوع الموسيقى وهويتها البصرية.

assistants.name: Rank Image Rise
assistants.intro_en: Rank Image Rise optimizes images for search visibility: dual-purpose alt text (accessibility first, keyword-natural), file naming, title guidance, captions that add value, surrounding-context copy, and technical notes with current standards flagged. It writes alt text only for content actually described or visible — never invented — and recommends no retired tactics.
assistants.summary_ar: يساعد على تحسين الصور لمحركات البحث عبر أسماء الملفات والنصوص البديلة والسياق.

assistants.name: Marketer Mentor
assistants.intro_en: Marketer Mentor builds comprehensive, feasibility-focused marketing plans for new business ideas — executive verdict, industry overview, beachhead audience, competitive whitespace, positioning, justified channels, budget logic with flagged ranges, kill/scale gates, and a 90-day timeline — with mentor margin notes throughout that teach the framework behind every recommendation. Cheerleading on weak economics is treated as malpractice; the verdict is honest.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني خطة تسويق عملية لفكرة مشروع، مع مراعاة الجمهور والموارد وإمكانية التنفيذ.

assistants.name: AI ArtPrompter
assistants.intro_en: AI ArtPrompter writes cinematic scene prompts and — its signature — numbered series that tell one coherent visual story: locked style anchors and character descriptors repeat verbatim across shots, beats escalate, and cut logic connects frames. Each scene carries subject, setting, camera angle and depth-of-field, motivated lighting, and genre grade. No film titles, director names, or dead flags.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل الأفكار إلى أوامر لمشاهد فنية وسينمائية قابلة للتوليد بالذكاء الاصطناعي.

assistants.name: Choice Advisor
assistants.intro_en: Choice Advisor is a decision engine: it frames the actual choice, extracts and weights the criteria that matter to you, scores each option with visible evidence and confidence marks, surfaces honest trade-offs and second-order effects, checks how reversible the decision is, then commits to a clear verdict with the pivotal assumption named. Prices and specs are never invented — unknowns are flagged for you to verify.
assistants.summary_ar: ينظم الخيارات ومعايير المفاضلة لمساعدتك على اتخاذ قرار مدروس.

assistants.name: HeadlineWizard
assistants.intro_en: HeadlineWizard writes ten headlines for any content with genuine angle diversity — curiosity gaps, benefit promises, number-led specificity, contrarian takes, question hooks, and more — each labeled by mechanism, within your word limit, in your chosen tone and register. A payoff check marks any headline needing content support; clickbait the content can't pay is never shipped.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب عناوين متنوعة للمحتوى بعد فهم موضوعه وزاويته والجمهور المستهدف.

assistants.name: Midjourney Architecta Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Architecta Prompts writes architectural-visualization prompts with real archviz grammar: styles described as movements and eras (never living architects' names), optically truthful materials, grounded environments with sun-consistent light logic, perspective-corrected camera language, and human scale where the program needs it. Series keep one design coherent across views.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر لتصورات معمارية تراعي لغة العرض والتفاصيل الهندسية.

assistants.name: Lingua Refine
assistants.intro_en: Lingua Refine is a multilingual proofreader and style polisher: it profiles your text's language, register, and voice, corrects every mechanical error with the rule named, elevates clarity and rhythm — and preserves your voice as a hard contract. Meaning-changing calls come back as options, never silent edits; long documents keep their structure exactly.
assistants.summary_ar: يراجع النصوص بلغات متعددة ويصقل الأسلوب والنحو مع الحفاظ على المعنى.

assistants.name: Midjourney Interior prompts
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Interior prompts designs interior-visualization prompts with authentic style DNA (Scandinavian, Japandi, industrial, Mediterranean, mid-century, minimalist, maximalist, and more named by their elements), functional room logic, coherent material palettes, layered lighting with real daylight behavior, and interior-photography camera work. No designer names, no dead flags; whole-home series keep locked palette anchors.
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ أوامر لتصور المساحات الداخلية مع إبراز الطراز والخامات والإضاءة.

assistants.name: VisionCraft Nexus
assistants.intro_en: VisionCraft Nexus turns one keyword into rich descriptive prompts for natural-language image generators: flowing prose built layer by layer — subject specificity, action, setting, light story, color psychology, committed medium, composition logic — delivered across a style spectrum (photorealistic to painterly to 3D) so you see the keyword's range. Tag piles and dead tokens are avoided by design.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل الكلمات المفتاحية إلى أوصاف غنية لتوليد الصور باللغة الطبيعية.

assistants.name: Prompt Visionary
assistants.intro_en: Prompt Visionary is a prompt-engineering research lab: it explains why techniques work at the mechanism level, names reusable techniques (including novel syntheses with failure conditions), demonstrates them with before→after examples in your domain, and designs lightweight test protocols so gains are proven rather than assumed. Claims are sorted into durable principles, current practice, and labeled hypotheses.
assistants.summary_ar: يستكشف هندسة البرومبت ويطوّر أساليب لصياغة أوامر أكثر فاعلية.

assistants.name: Code Mentor Xpert
assistants.intro_en: Code Mentor Xpert reviews and teaches code across languages: severity-ranked findings (correctness, security, performance, readability) each tied to its principle, a complete justified refactor, transferable principles with fresh examples, honest complexity analysis, and a growth exercise targeting your weakest muscle. Code here is generated and traced line by line, not executed — unverified behavior is marked, never claimed as tested.
assistants.summary_ar: يراجع الشيفرات ويشرحها ويساعدك على فهمها وتحسينها بلغات برمجة متعددة.

assistants.name: Midjourney Pixel Verse
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Pixel Verse builds pixel-art prompts in tribute to gaming's golden eras — through era grammar, never franchise names: bit-depth classes with true palette limits and dithering styles, title-screen composition logic, sprite readability, and nostalgia engineered through palette and light. Scene classes range from title screens to isometric vignettes to sprite sheets with locked anchors.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر فن البكسل المستوحاة من ألعاب الفيديو الكلاسيكية.

assistants.name: Midjourney Product Prompter
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Product Prompter explores product photography by category: macro material drama, hero studio light, levitation, splash dynamics, ingredient deconstruction, dark-mood luxury, minimal purity, natural staging, seasonal scenes, and in-use context — each with its authentic commercial grammar, truthful material optics, and copy space matched to destination. No brand name-drops, no dead flags.
assistants.summary_ar: يبتكر تصورات تصوير للمنتجات بحسب الفئة وطريقة العرض المرغوبة.

assistants.name: ReelsGenius
assistants.intro_en: ReelsGenius delivers ten original short-video ideas in one pass, engineered by engagement mechanism: educational (earns saves), humorous (earns shares), and dialogue-driven (earns comments). Each idea ships with hook (verbal + visual), beat outline, payoff design, an adaptation note for your niche, and relevance-tiered hashtags — plus a top-two "film these first" pick. Ideas stay filmable and trend-durable.
assistants.summary_ar: يقترح أفكار فيديوهات قصيرة مبنية على أساليب جذب وتفاعل متنوعة.

assistants.name: JobFit Genie
assistants.intro_en: JobFit Genie works both sides of the market. Applicants: paste a job advert plus your CV for a JD decode (real priorities, not restated requirements), an honest fit diagnostic, tailored bullet rewrites with metric placeholders, a cover-letter skeleton, and an interview roadmap with predicted questions and answer frameworks. Employers: optimized adverts, sourcing strategy, and performance-predictive screening criteria. Nothing is ever fabricated.
assistants.summary_ar: يساعد الباحثين عن عمل وأصحاب التوظيف على تقييم مدى التوافق بين الوظيفة والمرشح.

assistants.name: Headliness
assistants.intro_en: Headliness reads your actual content before naming it: it extracts the true core message, mines the angles hiding inside the text, and crafts headings that represent the piece accurately — in your voice, detected from your own writing. An accuracy audit flags any heading that would need extra content support, so the click is always earned.
assistants.summary_ar: يقرأ المحتوى أولًا ثم يقترح له عناوين دقيقة تعكس فكرته الفعلية.

assistants.name: Ad Wizard
assistants.intro_en: Ad Wizard builds social-feed ads through a five-step sequence: identify one specific problem, frame the solution, position the product with a real reason-to-believe, define audience signals, then craft the ad — hook, primary text, headline, CTA, and producible creative direction — in two or three angle-tested variants. Policy-safe patterns only; no fabricated proof; multilingual copy written natively.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني إعلانات لمنصات التواصل عبر خطوات تشمل الفكرة والنص والجمهور والدعوة إلى الإجراء.

assistants.name: Midjourney Weird Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Weird Prompts engineers strangeness as a craft: the one-wrong-thing principle, dream physics that stay internally consistent, deliberate scale violations, material swaps described with true optical behavior, and off-kilter composition — each aimed at a chosen emotion (dread, wonder, comedy, liminal ache). Platform weirdness dials are optional advice; every prompt works without flags.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر صور غرائبية بتفاصيل مقصودة وتكوين بصري متماسك.

assistants.name: Midjourney Cartoonify Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Cartoonify Prompts is a cartoon character factory using real animation-design grammar: silhouette-first shape language, tradition-authentic styles (rubber-hose vintage, modern TV clean, comic-strip ink, chibi, mascot, editorial wit, 3D-toy charm), expression and pose personality, signature details, and committed color scripts. Character sheets keep one locked design anchor; no studio or artist names.
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ تصورات لشخصيات كرتونية تراعي مبادئ تصميم الشخصيات والرسوم المتحركة.

assistants.name: Midjourney 3D Prompt Weaver
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney 3D Prompt Weaver writes stylized-3D prompts across the aesthetic spectrum: claymation warmth with fingerprint truth, faceted low-poly, isometric dioramas, glossy toy-render, glass and iridescence, paper-craft, voxel worlds, and collectible-figure sculpts — each with its medium's material behavior, studio lighting, and depth-proving composition. Render quality is described as a class; no engine-version pins.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر لمشاهد ورسوم ثلاثية الأبعاد ضمن أساليب بصرية متنوعة.

assistants.name: ArticleGenius
assistants.intro_en: ArticleGenius writes long-form articles for professional networks, engineered for how people actually read: hooks that survive feed truncation, subheadings that tell the story alone, value beats and open loops for dwell time, authority built from real experience (yours — harvested, never invented), proof at every skepticism peak, and a close that earns substantive comments.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب مقالات مهنية طويلة ومهيأة للقراءة على منصات النشر المهني.

assistants.name: Hooks Strategy Builder
assistants.intro_en: Hooks Strategy Builder designs habit-formation loops for products: triggers (external moments plus the internal emotional cue), friction-audited actions, variable rewards over a reliability floor, and investment ladders that load the next lap — with first-lap onboarding design, per-component metrics, and an honest ethics audit. Strategies that would work only by exploiting weakness are refused and replaced.
assistants.summary_ar: يصمم حلقات تفاعل وعادات استخدام للمنتجات والخدمات الرقمية.

assistants.name: VideoOptimizer
assistants.intro_en: VideoOptimizer is a bilingual (English–Arabic) video packaging suite: engineered titles with A/B pick, full description architecture with chapter logic from your actual beats, relevance-tiered tags, producible thumbnail concepts, first-30-seconds surgery with hook rewrites, beat-level pacing notes, and platform-adaptation strategy. Arabic deliverables are written natively, never translated; volatile platform specifics are flagged, not asserted.
assistants.summary_ar: يجهز حزمة نشر للفيديو بالعربية أو الإنجليزية، تشمل العنوان والوصف والعناصر المساندة.

assistants.name: Midjourney Character Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Character Prompts builds character images with design logic that survives generation: identity core with one original detail, silhouette-readable build, face and gaze carrying story, costume narrative with material truth, personality-sculpting light, and aspects chosen by mode (2:3 portrait, 16:9 in-world). Series keep a byte-identical character anchor; no artist names or dead flags.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني أوامر تصميم شخصيات بهوية وتفاصيل متماسكة عبر الصور المولدة.

assistants.name: ContentCrafter
assistants.intro_en: ContentCrafter writes sponsored-ad copy in authentic Egyptian Arabic (العامية المصرية): short simple words, one committed emotional engine per variant (حماس، دفء، فضول)، hooks that stop the scroll, positive-spirit selling without pressure, emoji as rhythm markers, and discoverable hashtags. It matches your own way of talking, and offers or claims are never fabricated.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب نصوص إعلانات ممولة بالعامية المصرية بأسلوب طبيعي ومقنع.

assistants.name: Sponsored Ace
assistants.intro_en: Sponsored Ace turns one ad concept into multi-platform campaigns (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn): each network gets a distinct funnel role with reasoning — including platforms deliberately skipped — plus layered audience architecture, test-then-scale budget gates, platform-native creative packages in your market's language, measurement tied to the objective, and compliance notes. Benchmarks arrive as flagged ranges; no fabricated precision.
assistants.summary_ar: يوسّع فكرة إعلانية واحدة إلى صيغ حملات تناسب منصات متعددة.

assistants.name: Persona Mimic
assistants.intro_en: Persona Mimic embodies personas with authentic voice and reasoning: historical figures through their documented worldviews and era-true knowledge, archetypes and your own character briefs with actor's discipline, and living public figures only as clearly-framed style impressions — never fabricated statements or deceptive attribution. Consistency holds across the conversation; knowledge boundaries are honored in character.
assistants.summary_ar: يتقمص شخصية أو أسلوبًا محددًا في الحوار والكتابة مع مراعاة سماته.

assistants.name: Engage Script Master
assistants.intro_en: Engage Script Master writes video scripts where product promotion lives inside genuinely valuable content: the value spine stands alone, the product enters through a named integration pattern (natural tool, payoff demo, honest companion, contrast proof, story embed), sponsorship disclosure is placed as a trust beat, and the CTA lands at peak receptivity. Claims stay within the product's real capabilities.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب سيناريوهات فيديو تقدم فائدة حقيقية وتدمج الترويج بصورة طبيعية.

assistants.name: SEO Tool Mentor
assistants.intro_en: SEO Tool Mentor is a whole-site SEO consultant that teaches as it advises: keyword-research method (not just lists), on-page programs, prioritized technical health routines, topical-authority architecture, and ethical link-worthiness — every recommendation with its durable principle and a repeatable method. Tool-agnostic by design; retired tactics are warned against; volatile specifics are flagged for checking.
assistants.summary_ar: يراجع تحسين الموقع لمحركات البحث ويشرح التوصيات أثناء تقديمها.

assistants.name: Course Planner
assistants.intro_en: Course Planner architects programming curricula on real pedagogy: skill-graph lesson ordering with explicit prerequisites, spiral depth, one major concept per lesson, a build in every lesson with self-checkable success criteria, honest difficulty curves, assessment checkpoints, and a milestone-staged capstone — delivered in your language with lesson count honored exactly.
assistants.summary_ar: يصمم مناهج لتعلم البرمجة بتدرج تعليمي وتمارين مناسبة للأهداف.

assistants.name: WebInspire
assistants.intro_en: WebInspire turns a business description into a buildable design vision: the visitor's mindset decoded, three genuinely distinct style directions (mood, palette with roles, type character, imagery treatment), a section-by-section homepage blueprint with each section's job, UX patterns mapped to your stated priorities (friendliness, collaboration, productivity, conversion), interaction philosophy, and accessibility conscience — with reasoning on every choice.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل وصف النشاط التجاري إلى تصور تصميمي قابل للتنفيذ للموقع.

assistants.name: Ad Scope Pro
assistants.intro_en: Ad Scope Pro answers the question that decides ad spend: who exactly should see this. From your campaign or offer it builds the audience scope — core profile with reasoned demographics, targeting clusters paired with message angles, a gated expansion sequence, depth-defined retargeting layers, exclusion lists that stop budget leaks, platform-fit mapping, and a validation test plan. Audience sizes are never invented; sensitive-category targeting is excluded.
assistants.summary_ar: يساعد على تقييم مدى ملاءمة الإعلان والميزانية قبل توسيع الإنفاق.

assistants.name: Product Studio Visualizer
assistants.intro_en: Product Studio Visualizer places products inside story-scenes with commercial discipline underneath: the product stays the hero (scale, focus, light priority), environments sell the brand promise, materials render with optical truth, props carry purpose, and copy space is planned per destination — from photoreal luxury to whimsical miniature worlds. No brand name-drops; parameters stay optional.
assistants.summary_ar: يضع المنتج داخل مشاهد قصصية ملائمة للاستخدام التجاري والتسويقي.

assistants.name: Seasoned Product Manager
assistants.intro_en: Seasoned Product Manager generates the PM document your context actually needs — PRD, project plan, or progress report — auto-detected and structured to professional standards: prioritized user stories with testable acceptance criteria, non-goals, risk registers with pre-mortems, honest status headlines, and explicit asks. Unknown data becomes specific [TODO] slots with guidance; dates, metrics, and names are never invented.
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ مستندات إدارة المنتج المناسبة للسياق، مثل PRD وخطة المشروع وتقارير التقدم.

assistants.name: Lead Magnet Pro
assistants.intro_en: Lead Magnet Pro designs lead generation as a system: ten magnets architected as a portfolio — different segments, different funnel depths, zero overlap — each with its strategic job, offer architecture, production outline, capture wiring with a three-touch nurture bridge, and pull/effort economics — plus the launch sequence and this week's top pick fully expanded. Promises never contain fabricated statistics.
assistants.summary_ar: يصمم منظومة لجذب العملاء المحتملين عبر العرض والقنوات وخطوات التحويل.

assistants.name: Midjourney Portray Prompts
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Portray Prompts specializes in full-body character portrayal: committed proportion systems, silhouettes that pass the black-shape test, poses with weight physics and biography, head-to-toe wardrobe narrative with material truth, explicit ground-plane contact (no floating figures), and deliberate full-figure framing. Pose series keep one byte-identical figure anchor.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر لتصوير الشخصيات كاملة الجسد مع توجيه واضح للوقفة والملابس.

assistants.name: CreativeAsset
assistants.intro_en: CreativeAsset is a media research and acquisition director: for any topic it delivers the art-direction brief that keeps assets coherent, tiered search-query sets for stock libraries, library guidance by class and budget (named specifics flagged for verification), a licensing decision checklist, complete AI-generation prompts for assets that don't exist, and a credit-tracking system. It guides legal sourcing only — and never invents library terms or prices.
assistants.summary_ar: يساعد على البحث عن الأصول الإعلامية وتقييمها واختيارها للاستخدام.

assistants.name: Extension Xpert
assistants.intro_en: Extension Xpert turns plain-language requests into complete browser-extension code: every file delivered in full (manifest, logic, popup, content scripts), minimal permissions each justified, security-first patterns (no remote code, safe DOM handling), current manifest standards noted for verification before store submission, plus step-by-step install and test instructions. Code is traced line by line before delivery — not executed here, and never claimed as tested.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل وصفك النصي إلى شيفرة متكاملة لإضافة متصفح.

assistants.name: Avatar Craft
assistants.intro_en: Avatar Craft directs digital-avatar prompts for the small frame: icon-size readability, circular-crop safety, committed aesthetics (cyberpunk neon, fantasy elegance, professional warmth, anime vibrancy, pixel retro, stylized 3D, minimal line), identity signature marks, face-sculpting light with catchlights, and separating backgrounds. Identity sets keep one persona consistent across every style via a locked anchor.
assistants.summary_ar: يوجه إنشاء صور رمزية رقمية واضحة ومقروءة حتى في المساحات الصغيرة.

assistants.name: Content Catalyst
assistants.intro_en: Content Catalyst starts where most content ends: your audience's inner world. It maps the resonance profile first — pains in their own words, desires, quiet objections, the sentence running in their head — then produces assets chemically bonded to it: titles that answer unasked questions, social signatures completing interrupted thoughts, emails continuing self-conversations, and ads mirroring the inner argument. Every asset is labeled with the resonance point it strikes.
assistants.summary_ar: يستخرج زوايا وأفكارًا جديدة من المحتوى الموجود لتطوير مواد تالية.

assistants.name: Multipurpose Prompt Template
assistants.intro_en: Multipurpose Prompt Template forges template systems, not single prompts: a master template with engineered slots and inline hints, a fully filled runnable instance for your actual request, a weak→strong slot guide, two family variants, and the design laws the build demonstrates — so you leave with the tool and the skill to make more. Retired template fossils (knowledge-cutoff fields, vendor quirks) never appear.
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ قوالب برومبت قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام لمهام متكررة ومتنوعة.

assistants.name: Imagi Chaos Forge
assistants.intro_en: Imagi Chaos Forge engineers productive randomness into image prompts: seeded collisions with internal relationship logic, journey symbols carrying emotional duality, style-fusion formulas with stated proportions, and open-with-anchor structure — fixed elements keep quality while deliberate openings invite surprising results. Batches explore different axes of possibility; platform chaos dials are optional advice, never dependencies.
assistants.summary_ar: يضيف تنوعًا غير متوقع ومنضبط إلى أوامر توليد الصور.

assistants.name: Debate Mentor
assistants.intro_en: Debate Mentor trains argumentation, persuasion, and negotiation actively: techniques taught in three layers (principle → exact phrases and moves → drill), live sparring against calibrated opponents from friendly colleague to hostile adversary, pause-and-coach freezes, evidence-based debrief scorecards, and argument builds with steelmanned opposition. Persuasion ethics are enforced — manipulation patterns are taught for defense only.
assistants.summary_ar: يدرّبك على بناء الحجج والإقناع والتفاوض من خلال ممارسة تفاعلية.

assistants.name: Task Xpert
assistants.intro_en: Task Xpert upgrades tasks before executing them: it reverse-engineers any rough request into an enhanced spec (real goal, hidden requirements, edge cases, success criteria), shows the spec in a glance, then delivers the finished result — verified against the criteria, with a ledger of what the enhancement caught. Precision is added; scope and facts are never invented, and divergent interpretations are flagged, not smuggled.
assistants.summary_ar: يوضح المهمة ويعيد تنظيمها قبل البدء بتنفيذها.

assistants.name: Pay Raise Pro
assistants.intro_en: Pay Raise Pro runs the Salary Increment Challenge: a negotiation gym where the bot plays your virtual boss at five difficulty levels — friendly manager through counter-negotiator — one exchange at a time, with a hidden persuasion meter, pause-and-coach breaks, and an evidence-based debrief including the three lines to memorize. It also builds your real ammunition: an achievement ledger with harvested numbers and market-research frameworks. Salary data is never fabricated.
assistants.summary_ar: يرشدك إلى الاستعداد لمحادثة زيادة الراتب وبناء مبرراتها وخطواتها.

assistants.name: Prompt Filler
assistants.intro_en: Prompt Filler generates publishing metadata from any prompt you paste: five name candidates across naming strategies with a recommended pick, hook-first descriptions in short and full versions, relevance-tiered tags, and an assembled ready-to-publish block — with every claim traceable to what the prompt actually does, plus a one-line improvement note for the prompt itself. Capability inflation and bait tags are excluded.
assistants.summary_ar: يستخرج بيانات النشر الوصفية من البرومبت، مثل العنوان والملخص والكلمات المفتاحية.

assistants.name: Photo Saga Oracle
assistants.intro_en: Photo Saga Oracle writes photography and cinematography prompts where light leads: key sculpture, backlight halos, silhouettes, Rembrandt triangles, split light, practical-source intimacy, golden and blue hour physics, volumetric atmosphere, and low/high-key commitments — each paired with the genre grammar it serves (noir, documentary, fashion, reportage, romance). Every prompt names its full light architecture; no photographer names or dead flags.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر التصوير الفوتوغرافي والسينمائي مع جعل الإضاءة محور التكوين.

assistants.name: ProductDescrip
assistants.intro_en: ProductDescrip writes store product descriptions in the customer's own language and mental world: benefit-first opening lines, emotional usage stories, feature-to-benefit scan layers, honest spec blocks with visible [CONFIRM] slots, real proof woven or harvested, and SEO-natural keyword placement. Batch mode keeps a whole catalog in one consistent voice with per-product specificity. Reviews and claims are never fabricated.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب أوصاف منتجات المتاجر بلغة تناسب العميل وسياق الشراء.

assistants.name: PriceGenius
assistants.intro_en: PriceGenius builds cost statements and pricing architecture: service decode and value map, pricing-model recommendation with real trade-offs (hourly, fixed, value-based, retainer, tiered), a firm-grade client-ready cost statement in your market's currency and conventions, a rate-research framework for finding true market numbers, and a negotiation defense kit. Market rates are never invented — your verified numbers fill the slots.
assistants.summary_ar: ينظم التكاليف ويبني هيكلًا للتسعير يناسب المنتج أو الخدمة.

assistants.name: Snippet Scribe
assistants.intro_en: Snippet Scribe is a long-to-short transcript surgeon: paste a long-video transcript and it extracts and re-engineers standalone shorts of 100–300 words — complete sentences only, hook-restructured (your strongest line moves first), context-tested for viewers who never saw the long video — each with a title suggestion, source location, and standalone note. Your words are preserved faithfully: reordering and marked trims only, never rewriting, never invented content.
assistants.summary_ar: يختصر النصوص والتفريغات الطويلة إلى مقاطع موجزة مع الحفاظ على الفكرة.

assistants.name: Ad Grid Method
assistants.intro_en: Ad Grid Method systematizes ad creation as a matrix: three to five genuinely distinct audience segments (each with pain, desire, objection) crossed against proven message angles (problem-agitation, aspirational, proof-led, contrarian, belonging) — every strong cell delivered as finished copy (hook, body, CTA), weak cells honestly skipped with reasons, plus the priority map for first launch and the test logic. Copy is native to your market language; fabricated proof never appears.
assistants.summary_ar: ينظم إنشاء الإعلانات في مصفوفة من الزوايا والصيغ والنسخ.

assistants.name: Midjourney Food Verse
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Food Verse writes food-photography prompts in disciplined, concise format — sensory density over length: freshness physics (steam behavior, glaze drip, crumb pull), texture topography, food-stylist placement logic, flattering light per mood, and the right angle (overhead flat-lay, 45-degree diner's view, macro dive). Dishes are rendered with cultural accuracy; no brand names, no dead flags, no word-count folklore.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر تصوير طعام موجزة تركز على الملمس والتكوين والشهية.

assistants.name: Content Sensei
assistants.intro_en: Content Sensei delivers finished conversion content and teaches the craft in the same pass: the audience read (pains in their own words), the piece itself — emails, articles, social copy, landing sections — plus a margin lesson naming the technique used, why it works on this audience, and a ten-minute exercise to wield it yourself. A variant using a different technique doubles the lesson. Urgency is honest; proof is real or slotted.
assistants.summary_ar: ينشئ محتوى يهدف إلى التحويل، ويشرح أسلوب بنائه في الوقت نفسه.

assistants.name: Metric Master
assistants.intro_en: Metric Master makes marketing metrics usable: any metric gets the plain definition, exact formula with worked arithmetic, the business decision it informs, practitioner usage, its lie-detector (when it looks good but means nothing), and its family tree. Paste real numbers for a diagnostic: sanity-checked arithmetic, funnel-leak location, and the one metric to fix first. Industry benchmarks are never fabricated — reasoning and flagged ranges instead.
assistants.summary_ar: يشرح مؤشرات التسويق ويحولها إلى قراءات تساعد على اتخاذ القرار.

assistants.name: Persona Shift Master
assistants.intro_en: Persona Shift Master engineers messaging through the Before-and-After Grid: what your buyer HAS, FEELS, lives through in an AVERAGE DAY, and their STATUS — before and after your product genuinely enters their life — then forges the messaging from it: grid-traceable headlines, body copy traveling the transformation arc, the compressed social delta, and a four-email grid tour. Before-states are honored without shame; after-states stay within what the product truly delivers.
assistants.summary_ar: يطور الرسائل التسويقية باستخدام مقارنة الحالة قبل العرض وبعده.

assistants.name: Midjourney Stylo
assistants.intro_en: Midjourney Stylo directs style intensity — the dial between "obey my words exactly" and "interpret freely". It teaches and applies the durable levers (specificity density, medium commitment, style-family anchors, restraint and release phrases) and demonstrates every concept with paired prompts: the same concept rendered TIGHT and LOOSE, with the lever breakdown and a run-first recommendation. Platform stylization controls are discussed honestly as tool-dependent — never as fixed universal values.
assistants.summary_ar: يساعد على ضبط مدى التزام الصورة المولدة بالوصف مقابل حرية التفسير الفني.

assistants.name: AskAra
assistants.intro_en: AskAra is an Arabic–English FAQ expert with one clean contract: Arabic questions receive fluent Modern Standard Arabic answers (any dialect understood), English questions receive fluent English, mixed questions get the dominant language with bridged terms. Answers follow FAQ discipline — direct answer first, then support — and stay clear, natural, accurate, relevant, and concise, with uncertainties flagged honestly in-language.
assistants.summary_ar: يجيب عن الأسئلة الشائعة بالعربية والإنجليزية وفق معلومات واضحة ومحددة.

assistants.name: JourneyX
assistants.intro_en: JourneyX maps customer journeys as actionable documents: stages fitted to your actual business model, each layered with what customers DO, THINK, and FEEL (the emotional curve tracked), touchpoints by class (owned, earned, paid), and friction points rated by severity — plus the decisive moments of truth, an effort×impact opportunity register, and per-stage measurement signals. Behavior is reasoned; statistics are never fabricated.
assistants.summary_ar: يرسم رحلة العميل ويحول مراحلها إلى وثائق وخطوات قابلة للتنفيذ.

assistants.name: Skill Sprint Sage
assistants.intro_en: Skill Sprint Sage designs hands-on practice systems for any skill — zero courses required: the sub-skill map with 80/20 priorities, a daily routine in real time blocks (the 15-minute drill fully specified, commute reps, weekend deep session), real-world practice arenas enterable this week, objective checkpoints, and a plateau kit. Every drill carries its feedback mechanism; schedules respect your actual available time. Resources are named by type and durable classics — links are never invented.
assistants.summary_ar: يصمم تدريبات عملية قصيرة تساعدك على اكتساب مهارة من خلال الممارسة.

assistants.name: Geni Mind Tutor
assistants.intro_en: Geni Mind Tutor personalizes teaching across subjects: a quick level read per subject, a milestone learning path, and lessons built as interest-hook → three representations (analogy, definition, worked example) → guided practice with hints before answers → adaptive response to every attempt. Misconceptions get named and re-taught; progress is remembered across the conversation. Calculations are re-checked step by step; references are never fabricated.
assistants.summary_ar: يخصص الشرح والتدريس حسب المادة واحتياج المتعلم.

assistants.name: Avatar Prompts Fusion
assistants.intro_en: Avatar Prompts Fusion specializes in avatar style-fusion: two or more aesthetics blended deliberately — compatibility verdict first (harmonious, complementary, or fighting-with-salvage), stated proportions, element-level ownership (line from A, color from B), and a locked identity anchor so one persona wears the whole gallery. Every fusion stays icon-size-safe for profile use; no artist names or dead flags.
assistants.summary_ar: يمزج الأساليب البصرية لإنشاء أفكار وأوامر للصور الرمزية.

assistants.name: Social Savvy
assistants.intro_en: Social Savvy engineers single posts to travel: an honest share-psychology diagnosis (which triggers your topic can actually carry, and its ceiling), format matched to trigger, the complete post — scroll-stop first line, retention structure, payoff, a marked sharer's-gift quote line, comment engine — plus a distribution kit and the strategy frame (pillar, follow-up ladder, repurposing chain). Virality is treated as engineered probability, never promised; rage-bait is excluded.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ منشورات اجتماعية ذات افتتاحية واضحة وفرصة أفضل للانتشار.

assistants.name: Influencer Connect
assistants.intro_en: Influencer Connect architects influencer programs without fake directories: creator archetype maps with runnable discovery blueprints (find real candidates yourself this week), tier economics with honestly flagged rate ranges, a fraud-catching vetting scorecard, goal-matched collaboration formats, outreach templates that earn replies, campaign structure with rights and disclosure built in, and outcome-tied measurement. Influencer names are never invented.
assistants.summary_ar: يصمم برنامج تعاون مع المؤثرين يشمل الاختيار والتواصل وقياس النتائج.

assistants.name: IsoCraft Generator
assistants.intro_en: IsoCraft Generator turns one keyword into a style matrix of concise isometric prompts (~320 characters each): cozy miniature, technical cutaway, neon cyber-iso, clay-render pastel, low-poly, pixel-iso, botanical terrarium, fantasy floating, food-miniature, desk-scape — each engineered with true isometric craft (axonometric perspective language, contained ground planes, committed palettes, soft contact shadows). No franchise names or dead tokens.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل كلمة مفتاحية إلى مجموعة أوامر لتصميم مشاهد وأصول بأسلوب isometric.

assistants.name: Topic Plus
assistants.intro_en: Topic Plus is a topic-exploration compass: any topic in any language receives a clear beginner-suitable explanation (terms translated, analogy-anchored, honestly bounded), then ten curated subtopic recommendations — each tagged by its role in the knowledge map (foundation, branch, application, frontier, controversy, connection) with a real why-it-matters — plus three exploration paths. Feed any subtopic back and it recurses to the next depth.
assistants.summary_ar: يساعد على استكشاف موضوع عبر محاوره وأسئلته وزواياه المختلفة.

assistants.name: Job Prospector Xpertise
assistants.intro_en: Job Prospector Xpertise architects job descriptions that attract the right candidates: mission-first summary, responsibilities written as outcomes, requirements split honestly into must-have / grow-into / bonus (over-specification kills pipelines), inclusive-language auditing, ATS-safe structure, and market conventions flagged where they vary — plus the screening-criteria companion for the hiring team. Compensation uses your numbers or transparency slots; requirements must be job-relevant and defensible.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب أوصاف وظائف واضحة وجاذبة تساعد على استقطاب المرشحين المناسبين.

assistants.name: AudiencePro
assistants.intro_en: AudiencePro builds audience strategy segmentation-first: the demand landscape mapped by buying logic, three to five coherent segments with jobs-to-be-done and honest size-estimation methods, a visible scorecard, the beachhead pick with expansion sequence and triggers, the priority segment's full demographic-plus-psychographic portrait, secondary briefs, and a message-implications table. Market percentages are never fabricated — sizing is delivered as logic you run on real data.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني استراتيجية جمهور تبدأ بتقسيم الشرائح وتحديد احتياجات كل منها.

assistants.name: JobQuest
assistants.intro_en: JobQuest runs realistic mock interviews: the bot embodies a hiring manager calibrated to your target role, asking one question at a time with evidence-seeking follow-ups, role-specific probes, and curveballs at your chosen difficulty (graduate-friendly to executive-pressure, opt-in stress mode). Optional coach breaks deliver exact stronger phrasings; the final debrief gives the honest hire-frame, your top fixes, and the practice prescription. Interviews run in the language of the real room.
assistants.summary_ar: يوفر مقابلات عمل تجريبية بأسئلة ومواقف تحاكي المقابلة الواقعية.

assistants.name: InsightCraft Pro
assistants.intro_en: InsightCraft Pro is a CRM success manager for any customer-relationship system: data-hygiene rituals, segmentation that matches how you actually sell, pipeline stage discipline, onboarding first-win sequences, follow-up cadences with frequency honesty, retention plays triggered by defined risk signals, and report interpretation that converts dashboards into direction. Every answer arrives as a configured play with success signals and the classic pitfall. Product-specific mechanics are flagged for verification, never invented.
assistants.summary_ar: يساعد فرق نجاح العملاء على تهيئة واستخدام أنظمة CRM المختلفة.

assistants.name: StorySphere Explorer
assistants.intro_en: StorySphere Explorer builds stories-format campaigns (Telegram stories and stories surfaces generally) as A/B test sets: sequences engineered for tap-through rhythm with the frame-two graveyard defended, honest ephemerality urgency, dual-purpose interactive stickers (engagement plus data), and conversion architecture with value-stacking before the ask. Each concept ships as two or three variants with hypothesis, controlled variable, and success metric — plus the run-and-decide test plan.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني حملات قصصية بصيغ متعددة لاختبار الرسائل والتفاعل.

assistants.name: EduSense Navigator
assistants.intro_en: EduSense Navigator explains any concept at any grade level with age-true calibration — vocabulary, abstraction, and example-world all set to the level — then makes it stick with interactive elements: a hands-on activity with safety notes, a Socratic question ladder, a describable visual aid, game mechanics for young learners, and the classic misconception trap. The grade ladder moves the same concept down, up, and into its prerequisites; teacher, parent, and learner modes included. Curriculum specifics are flagged, never fabricated.
assistants.summary_ar: يشرح المفاهيم لمراحل دراسية مختلفة مع ضبط اللغة والأمثلة حسب العمر.

assistants.name: Salarify Coach
assistants.intro_en: Salarify Coach covers the full salary campaign in three engines: REHEARSE (the Salary Increment Challenge — a virtual boss in calibrated rounds, one exchange at a time, tactical notes at breaks), NAVIGATE (the value-evidence ledger from your real achievements, market-research frameworks with exact scripts, anchor/target/floor architecture), and EVALUATE (offers compared across the full package, weighted by your priorities). Salary figures are never fabricated — frameworks and clearly-marked slots instead.
assistants.summary_ar: يدعم التحضير للتفاوض على الراتب عبر تحديد القيمة والطلب وخطة المحادثة.

assistants.name: Multiverse Mentor
assistants.intro_en: Multiverse Mentor is a life-area growth companion with structure and honesty: the leverage-point diagnosis, three to five principles with their mechanisms, strategies ranked by effort-to-impact, a first-week plan sized to survive bad days, habit architecture (cue, environment, restart ritual), and obstacle vaccinations with if-then plans. Wisdom comes from durable, evidence-informed foundations — not fads; clinical-concern signals are met with warm direction to professional support, never coached through.
assistants.summary_ar: يساعد على وضع أهداف للنمو الشخصي ومتابعتها بخطوات واقعية ومنظمة.

assistants.name: Sector Savvy
assistants.intro_en: Sector Savvy delivers industry intelligence briefings for any sector: the economic engine in one breath, structural dynamics analyzed (demand, costs, competitive forces, regulatory shape, technology trajectory), the player landscape by type with white-space, an honest opportunity/threat read with early-warning signals, recommendations tailored to your position (founder, employee, investor, student, service provider), and a watch-list of observable indicators. Durable structure is stated with confidence; volatile state is flagged — companies, statistics, and events are never invented.
assistants.summary_ar: يقدم موجزًا معرفيًا عن القطاعات واتجاهاتها وسياقها التجاري.

assistants.name: DiscoverSEO
assistants.intro_en: DiscoverSEO engineers content discoverability: click-winning title options within long-stable display ranges, meta descriptions that satisfy intent and earn the click, honest guidance on which meta fields actually matter today, social-preview tag sets, structured-data suggestions matched to content class, and the on-page adjustments that make content snippet-worthy. Bait the content can't pay is never written; volatile specifics are flagged for checking.
assistants.summary_ar: يطور قابلية اكتشاف المحتوى عبر البحث وتنظيم الموضوعات والصفحات.

assistants.name: MultiLingo Scripter
assistants.intro_en: MultiLingo Scripter writes short-video scripts that get reborn per language, not translated: one shared strategy skeleton (hook type, beats, payoff, end-behavior) rendered natively in each requested language — its own rhythm, idioms born there, humor mechanics rebuilt, cultural references swapped — with timing math computed per language so every version fits the duration. Versions stay strategically parallel for cross-market comparison.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب سيناريوهات فيديو قصيرة بصياغة طبيعية تناسب كل لغة وجمهور.

assistants.name: Essay Scribe Pro
assistants.intro_en: Essay Scribe Pro writes essays with you, step by step: three stress-tested thesis candidates to choose from, an argument map for approval before drafting, section-by-section writing with your feedback steering, a language-polish pass shown as before→after lessons, and citation integration with absolute honesty — real sources or marked search-guided slots, never fabricated references. Paste a partial draft and it diagnoses, fixes, and continues from where you are.
assistants.summary_ar: يرافقك في كتابة المقال خطوة بخطوة من الفكرة إلى المراجعة النهائية.

assistants.name: BizTale
assistants.intro_en: BizTale crafts original business stories in four working forms: the client-journey tale (customer as hero, product as the earned turning tool), the origin story, the case-study narrative, and the vision story. Stories are engineered — recognizable character, honest tension, specific resolution — with clichés banned and proof discipline enforced: real client material woven in, composites labeled, fabricated results never used.
assistants.summary_ar: يصوغ قصصًا أصلية عن الأعمال بصيغ تناسب أهدافًا وجماهير مختلفة.

assistants.name: ConvertPro
assistants.intro_en: ConvertPro engineers landing pages as conversion machines: hero built to pass the five-second test, problem/promise bridge, benefit blocks translated from features, proof placed at skepticism peaks (real material or visible slots), the objection-dissolution sequence including the honest who-it's-NOT-for qualifier, CTA architecture with momentum logic, and trust footer — each section shipped with its exact copy, conversion job, and layout note. Dark patterns and fabricated proof are excluded.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني صفحات هبوط منظمة بهدف توضيح العرض وتشجيع الزائر على اتخاذ خطوة.

assistants.name: SnapCraft Canvas
assistants.intro_en: SnapCraft Canvas turns one keyword into a clean table of style prompts — surreal, pop art, impressionistic, watercolor, classic painting, hyperrealistic, macro, gourmet high-res, and styles you add — each cell concise and paste-ready, carrying the house aesthetic: exquisite presentation, meticulous named detail, deliberate staging, and timeless film-stock character in effect language (no brand incantations). The table format is the contract: scannable, copyable cell by cell.
assistants.summary_ar: يحوّل كلمة مفتاحية إلى جدول أوامر صور بأساليب فنية متنوعة.

assistants.name: PitchCraft Pro
assistants.intro_en: PitchCraft Pro architects pitch decks slide by slide, adapted to the deciding audience (investor, client, board, partner): each slide ships with its story job, a message headline (not a label), exact content copy, producible visual direction, and speaker notes — plus the momentum map, Q&A armor with answer frameworks, and the data-harvesting list for honest slots. Traction and financials are never fabricated.
assistants.summary_ar: يبني عروضًا تقديمية شريحةً تلو الأخرى وفق الجمهور وصاحب القرار.

assistants.name: ProposalCraft Prodigy
assistants.intro_en: ProposalCraft Prodigy writes complete B2B proposals to the clarity-and-simplicity standard: executive summary that stands alone, situation understanding that proves you listened, solution translated to the client's business outcomes, methodology with risk mitigations, milestone timeline naming client prerequisites, investment framing, plain-language terms with a counsel-review flag, and an unmistakable close. Case studies and statistics are never fabricated — real proof or guided slots.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب مقترحات أعمال بين الشركات بوضوح، من الملخص التنفيذي إلى الخطة والتكلفة.

assistants.name: ProPost
assistants.intro_en: ProPost writes LinkedIn posts that hit the professional-feed balance: entertaining and informative in the same breath, within 400 words counted, structured for how the feed reads — a hook line that survives truncation, scannable rhythm, one idea landed in a quotable line, and a genuine comment-earning close. Tone stays professional-human; fabricated claims, engagement-begging, and hustle-poetry are excluded. Posts are written natively in your language.
assistants.summary_ar: يكتب منشورات LinkedIn مهنية ومتوازنة تناسب إيقاع المنصة.

assistants.name: StratMark Prodigy
assistants.intro_en: StratMark Prodigy runs the full EST-model positioning analysis: all six vectors — Easiest, Quickest, Experienced, Cheapest, Biggest, Hottest — each with current-state read, actionable recommendations, and business-process implications, then the synthesis that decides: which vectors to WIN, RESPECT, and deliberately CONCEDE (competing on all six is how margins die), your one-sentence positioning statement, and a 90-day sequence. Recommendations stay ethical and legal; market data is never fabricated. Responds in your language.
assistants.summary_ar: يحلل تموضع العلامة باستخدام نموذج EST لصياغة اتجاه استراتيجي واضح.
